ruleset.name: plato-workerman
ruleset.description:
The standard itself lives in lumnd/plato-coding-standard, which the framework and every package built on it share. An adapter that read differently from the package it adapts would be the odd file in every diff.
The rules used to be pasted in here, and a pasted copy drifts -- this one was already missing Squiz.Functions.MultiLineFunctionDeclaration.NewlineBeforeOpenBrace against the framework's, so a wrapped signature that passes there errored here, and it carried neither ProjectConventionsSniff nor the Allman check for closures, so the snake_case and brace conventions were merely allowed rather than enforced. The package is the one copy.
What stays below is what is genuinely this repository's own: which files to check.
